label: Aluminium
description: Aluminium in furniture: Lightweight, corrosion resistant and dimensionally stable outdoors.
watchouts: surface dents more easily than steel
can heat up or cool down quickly
coating damage should be monitored in coastal use

label: Cotton
description: Cotton in furniture: Soft, breathable and absorbent, with a dry hand feel.
watchouts: wears faster than performance synthetics in heavy seating

label: Fabric
description: Fabric in furniture: Comfort-led surface layer whose feel depends on fibre mix, weave density and backing.

label: Faux leather
description: Faux leather in furniture: Smooth, easy to wipe and visually leather-like, but less breathable than real leather or fabric.
watchouts: can peel or crack with age
sensitive to heat and aggressive cleaners

label: Feather
description: Feather in furniture: High loft, soft compression and airy comfort with a relaxed, lounge-like sit.
watchouts: not ideal for sharply tailored shapes

label: Foam
description: Foam in furniture: Shape-forming, pressure-distributing and available from soft comfort layers to firm support cores.
watchouts: trapped moisture slows recovery and hygiene

label: Furniture board
description: Furniture board in furniture: Economical, flat and consistent across large surfaces.
strengths: works well for hidden structural boards
watchouts: screw holding depends on the core

label: Glass
description: Glass in furniture: Hard, non-porous and visually light, with a clean reflective surface.
watchouts: hard reflective surface increases glare and noise

label: HDF
description: HDF in furniture: Dense, smooth and stable in thin sections, often used for backs and secondary panels.
watchouts: limited screw holding in thin sections

label: Latex
description: Latex in furniture: Responsive, resilient and comparatively breathable for a foam material.
watchouts: heavier and costlier than standard foam
feel may be too buoyant for users who prefer deep sink-in comfort

label: MDF
description: MDF in furniture: Uniform, machinable and excellent for painted or veneered flat surfaces.
watchouts: edge fasteners are not as strong as in plywood or solid wood

label: Memory foam
description: Memory foam in furniture: Conforms closely to the body and rebounds more slowly than standard foam.
watchouts: slow rebound is not for everyone
needs a supportive base beneath it

label: Metal
description: Metal in furniture: Strong, precise and well suited to slim structural parts.
watchouts: can feel cold or hot to touch
coating damage may expose corrosion risk on steel

label: Mikrofiber
description: Mikrofiber in furniture: Evaluate it through structure, moisture tolerance, maintenance needs and how it supports the furniture's intended use.
strengths: depends on placement in the product
should be read together with finish and substrate
can still add useful comfort or structure
watchouts: maintenance depends on the full build
performance should be judged by the application, not the name alone

label: Nonwood
description: Nonwood in furniture: Stable and low-maintenance compared with natural wood, but exact performance depends on the composite recipe.
watchouts: heat expansion and surface ageing depend on formulation

label: Oak
description: Oak in furniture: Strong, hard-wearing and visually expressive with open grain.
watchouts: tannin staining with iron and water

label: Paper
description: Paper in furniture: Lightweight and design-flexible, but heavily dependent on coating and substrate support.
strengths: can create interesting woven or wrapped textures
watchouts: sensitive to moisture if the finish fails
abrasion can reveal the substrate quickly

label: Particle board
description: Particle board in furniture: Flat and economical, with acceptable bulk for hidden structures and faced panels.
strengths: flat stable panels in dry interiors
watchouts: swelling is often permanent once wet

label: Pine
description: Pine in furniture: Light, warm-looking and easy to machine, but softer under impact.
watchouts: knot movement and resin can influence finish

label: Plastic
description: Plastic in furniture: Easy to shape, moisture proof and often lighter than metal or wood.
watchouts: generic label does not reveal the exact polymer quality

label: Plywood
description: Plywood in furniture: Stronger and more dimensionally stable than many fibre or particle boards.
strengths: better screw holding than particle board
watchouts: edge plies may show or splinter
quality varies by veneer grade and glue line
needs protection in prolonged wet exposure

label: Polyester
description: Polyester in furniture: Durable, low-absorbency and comparatively easy to maintain.
watchouts: cheap variants may feel flat or shiny

label: Polypropylene
description: Polypropylene in furniture: Light, stain resistant and highly moisture tolerant.
watchouts: feel is usually more practical than luxurious

label: Polyrattan
description: Polyrattan in furniture: Flexible, weather-oriented and visually lighter than solid panel furniture.
watchouts: structural quality depends on hidden frame
strand brittleness can emerge with age

label: Silicate
description: Silicate in furniture: Hard, heat tolerant and visually crisp, with a dense mineral feel.
watchouts: performance depends on support and handling

label: Solid wood
description: Solid wood in furniture: Load bearing, repairable and rich in natural grain variation.
watchouts: can crack if design ignores movement
quality varies by species and cut

label: Steel
description: Steel in furniture: High stiffness and strength, excellent for thin load-bearing frames.
strengths: good fatigue performance in quality builds
watchouts: can rust if the finish fails

strengths: depends on placement in the product
should be read together with finish and substrate
can still add useful comfort or structure
watchouts: maintenance depends on the full build
performance should be judged by the application, not the name alone

label: Tencel

strengths: depends on placement in the product
should be read together with finish and substrate
can still add useful comfort or structure
watchouts: maintenance depends on the full build
performance should be judged by the application, not the name alone

label: Terracotta
description: Terracotta in furniture: Evaluate it through structure, moisture tolerance, maintenance needs and how it supports the furniture's intended use.
strengths: depends on placement in the product
should be read together with finish and substrate
can still add useful comfort or structure
watchouts: maintenance depends on the full build
performance should be judged by the application, not the name alone

label: Textilene
description: Textilene in furniture: Taut, quick drying and supportive without thick cushioning.
strengths: well suited to outdoor sling seating
watchouts: quality depends on mesh tension and coating
can heat up in strong sun

label: Viscose
description: Viscose in furniture: Soft, drapey and often slightly lustrous, with strong colour depth.
watchouts: not the toughest high-traffic fibre on its own

label: Wood
description: Wood in furniture: Warm, stiff and naturally variable in grain and tone.
watchouts: surface can dent or dry out if neglected

label: Wood veneer
description: Wood veneer in furniture: Gives authentic wood grain with more stable panel geometry than solid timber alone.
strengths: real wood appearance with panel stability
watchouts: edges and corners chip more easily
core material still controls moisture tolerance

label: Wool
description: Wool in furniture: Warm, springy and naturally textured, with good recovery under foot and hand.
